name: MSI Mystic Light 185 (MAG B550 Tomahawk)
description: Per-LED mode for the MSI MAG B550 TOMAHAWK (MS-7C91) / MPG B550 GAMING EDGE WIFI: the 6 onboard LEDs, the two 12 V RGB headers (JRGB1/2) and the strips on the two 5 V ARGB headers (JRAINBOW1/2, up to 120 LEDs each, 232 together), through HID feature reports 0x52 (configuration, 185 bytes) and 0x53 (colour stream, 725 bytes). The state read at start is restored on exit; nothing is saved to the controller's flash. Hardware notes: docs/hardware/msi-mystic-light-185.md.
